diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
index f064b2f5..d376267d 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -373,114 +373,115 @@ jobs:
           # `go build` skips _test.go entirely, so llamagpu's vulkan-tagged test
           # files were compiled by nothing — they could rot indefinitely while this
           # lane stayed green. `go vet` does compile them. Verified non-vacuous by
           # injecting a syntax error and confirming it is caught (unlike the cuda
           # corpus, whose OS constraint makes the same check compile nothing — see
           # the note in the cgo lane and ADR-0029).
           go vet -tags vulkan ./llamagpu/
       - name: run backend/vulkan tests — only if this change touches it AND an ICD is present (§T600)
         shell: bash
         run: |
           BASE="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}"
           AFFECTED=$(go run ./internal/cichange -impact "$BASE" HEAD || echo all)
           case "$AFFECTED" in
             all|*backend/vulkan*) ;;
             *) echo "skip: change does not touch backend/vulkan (affected: $AFFECTED) — rc=0"; exit 0;;
           esac
           if ! vulkaninfo --summary >/dev/null 2>&1; then
             echo "skip: no loadable Vulkan ICD on this runner — rc=0"; exit 0
           fi
           if vulkaninfo --summary 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "llvmpipe|swiftshader"; then
             export GOAI_VULKAN_SOFTWARE_ICD=1  # software ICD: known-divergent tests self-skip with reasons (T603)
           fi
           # `|| rc=$?` keeps the un-piped exit code (V24) AND survives bash -e: a bare
           # failing command would abort the script before the log excerpt ever prints —
           # exactly on failure, when the excerpt matters most (B53).
           rc=0
           go test -tags vulkan -short -count=1 -timeout 15m -v ./backend/vulkan/ > vk.log 2>&1 || rc=$?
           grep -E "^(--- (PASS|FAIL|SKIP)|ok |FAIL)|skipped:" vk.log | head -80 || true
           exit $rc
 
   # go.mod stays tidy (ollama pattern; zero-dep module today, this guards drift).
   tidy:
     name: go mod tidy
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
         with:
           go-version: "1.27.1"
           cache: false
       - uses: ./.github/actions/go-build-cache
         with:
           lane: tidy
       - name: go mod tidy must not change go.mod (dependency drift gate)
         run: |
           go mod tidy
           git diff --exit-code go.mod
 
   # §T604 capability matrix, simd axis: compile GOEXPERIMENT=simd on every
   # runner and execute the SIMD primitive tests. amd64 exercises archsimd;
   # arm64 exercises the native NEON leaves that are intentionally experiment-gated.
   simd:
     needs: changes
     if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
     name: simd / ${{ matrix.os }} (soft)
     runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
     continue-on-error: true
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
         os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
         with:
           go-version: "1.27.1"
           cache: false
       - uses: ./.github/actions/go-build-cache
         with:
           lane: simd-${{ matrix.os }}
       - name: capability probe (§T601 — what does this runner offer?)
         shell: bash
         run: go run ./internal/capprobe
       - name: compile and test with GOEXPERIMENT=simd
         shell: bash
         env:
           CGO_ENABLED: "0"
         run: |
           GOEXPERIMENT=simd go build -tags=simd ./...
           GOEXPERIMENT=simd go test -short -count=1 ./internal/simd
+          GOEXPERIMENT=simd go test -short -count=1 -v -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' ./nn
 
   # §T604 capability matrix, cgo axis on windows (mingw): the tagless cgo build
   # must behave like everywhere else; tests run selectively via the runner.
   test-windows-cgo:
     needs: changes
     if: needs.changes.outputs.code == 'true'
     name: cgo / windows
     runs-on: windows-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v7
         with:
           fetch-depth: 0 # §T587
       - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
         with:
           go-version: "1.27.1"
           cache: false
       - uses: ./.github/actions/go-build-cache
         with:
           lane: cgo-windows
       - name: capability probe (§T601 — what does this runner offer?)
         shell: bash
         run: go run ./internal/capprobe
       - name: compile everything with cgo enabled via go vet (mingw)
         shell: bash
         env:
           CGO_ENABLED: "1"
         run: go vet ./...
       - name: test (transparent selective run, §T587)
         shell: bash
         env:
           CGO_ENABLED: "1"
         run: |
           BASE="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}"
           go run ./internal/cichange -run "$BASE" HEAD -- -short -count=1 -timeout 20m
diff --git a/nn/kan_bitidentity_test.go b/nn/kan_bitidentity_test.go
index 48de1221..6338d7a9 100644
--- a/nn/kan_bitidentity_test.go
+++ b/nn/kan_bitidentity_test.go
@@ -1,54 +1,65 @@
 package nn
 
 import (
-	"github.com/jxsl13/goai/internal/archgold"
 	"math"
+	"runtime"
 	"testing"
 
 	"github.com/jxsl13/goai/backend"
+	"github.com/jxsl13/goai/internal/archgold"
 	"github.com/jxsl13/goai/tensor"
 )
 
 // TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical freezes the layer's output. Banding the fused spline over the
 // batch claims to change no value — a band never splits a row, so each row's accumulation over
 // the input dimension keeps the same ascending order — and a KAN is a smooth approximator whose
 // outputs would absorb a reassociation without any test noticing.
 //
 // The batch sizes straddle the fan-out gate: the 3-row case runs serially in both arms, the
 // 96-row case bands, and 13 is deliberately not a multiple of the worker count so the last
 // band is short.
 func TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical(t *testing.T) {
 	cases := []struct {
+		name           string
 		batch, in, out int
 		want           uint64
 	}{
-		{3, 5, 7, archgold.Pick(5936029728971432568, 14272068029666688409)},
-		{13, 8, 6, archgold.Pick(15159748691548848689, 6609257596807823200)},
-		{96, 24, 32, archgold.Pick(515177776064738749, 9025949438388873583)},
+		{"3x5x7", 3, 5, 7, archgold.Pick(5936029728971432568, 14272068029666688409)},
+		{"13x8x6", 13, 8, 6, archgold.Pick(15159748691548848689, 6609257596807823200)},
+		{"96x24x32", 96, 24, 32, archgold.Pick(515177776064738749, 9025949438388873583)},
 	}
+	cpuBE, ok := backend.Get(backend.CPU)
+	if !ok {
+		t.Fatal("cpu backend not registered")
+	}
+	t.Logf("compiler=%s os=%s arch=%s backend=cpu", runtime.Version(), runtime.GOOS, runtime.GOARCH)
+
+	// Independent subtests retain every fixture failure for feature and architecture qualification.
 	for _, c := range cases {
-		l, err := NewKAN(c.in, c.out, 1)
-		if err != nil {
-			t.Fatal(err)
-		}
-		x := tensor.New(tensor.F64, tensor.Shape{c.batch, c.in})
-		xs := x.Storage().F64()
-		for i := range xs {
-			xs[i] = math.Sin(float64(i*11+5)) * 0.6
-		}
-		y, err := l.Forward(backend.NewContext(), x)
-		if err != nil {
-			t.Fatal(err)
-		}
-		h := uint64(14695981039346656037)
-		for _, v := range y.Storage().F64() {
-			b := math.Float64bits(v)
-			for s := 0; s < 64; s += 8 {
-				h = (h ^ (b>>s)&0xff) * 1099511628211
+		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			l, err := NewKAN(c.in, c.out, 1)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			x := tensor.New(tensor.F64, tensor.Shape{c.batch, c.in})
+			xs := x.Storage().F64()
+			for i := range xs {
+				xs[i] = math.Sin(float64(i*11+5)) * 0.6
+			}
+			y, err := l.Forward(backend.NewContext().WithBackend(cpuBE), x)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			h := uint64(14695981039346656037)
+			for _, v := range y.Storage().F64() {
+				b := math.Float64bits(v)
+				for s := 0; s < 64; s += 8 {
+					h = (h ^ (b>>s)&0xff) * 1099511628211
+				}
+			}
+			if h != c.want {
+				t.Fatalf("%dx%dx%d digest %d, want %d", c.batch, c.in, c.out, h, c.want)
 			}
-		}
-		if h != c.want {
-			t.Fatalf("%dx%dx%d digest %d, want %d", c.batch, c.in, c.out, h, c.want)
-		}
+		})
 	}
 }

run-capture.sh.content:
#!/bin/zsh
set -u

artifact_dir=/private/tmp/goai-kan-native-ci-verify-OVhXde/artifacts
repo=/private/tmp/goai-kan-native-ci-verify-OVhXde/repo
tool_path=/private/tmp/goai-go1271-j1cLvq/go/bin:$PATH
cache_dir=/private/tmp/gocache-goai
modcache_dir=/private/tmp/goai-go1271-j1cLvq/modcache

run_capture() {
  local label="$1"
  local experiment="$2"
  shift 2
  {
    print -r -- "cwd=$repo"
    print -r -- "PATH=$tool_path"
    print -r -- "GOCACHE=$cache_dir"
    print -r -- "GOMODCACHE=$modcache_dir"
    print -r -- "GOTOOLCHAIN=local"
    print -r -- "CGO_ENABLED=0"
    print -r -- "GOEXPERIMENT=$experiment"
    print -n -- "argv="
    printf '%q ' "$@"
    print
  } > "$artifact_dir/$label.manifest"
  cd "$repo" || exit 70
  PATH="$tool_path" GOCACHE="$cache_dir" GOMODCACHE="$modcache_dir" GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0 GOEXPERIMENT="$experiment" "$@" > "$artifact_dir/$label.stdout" 2> "$artifact_dir/$label.stderr"
  local rc=$?
  print -r -- "$rc" > "$artifact_dir/$label.exit"
  return 0
}

case "${1:-}" in
  normal)
    run_capture default-focused '' go test ./nn -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' -count=1 -v
    run_capture simd-focused simd go test ./nn -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' -count=1 -v
    run_capture default-nn-short '' go test ./nn -short -count=1
    run_capture default-nn-vet '' go vet ./nn
    run_capture simd-cpu-bitidentity simd go test ./backend/cpu -run '^TestVsiluF64Arm64(Accuracy|VectorTailBitIdentity|Edges)$' -count=1 -v
    ;;
  mutation)
    run_capture mutation-default-focused '' go test ./nn -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' -count=1 -v
    ;;
  restored)
    run_capture restored-default-focused '' go test ./nn -run '^TestKANForwardIsBitIdentical$' -count=1 -v
    ;;
  *)
    print -u2 -r -- 'usage: run-capture.sh normal|mutation|restored'
    exit 64
    ;;
esac
